retrieved_context: 122nd SS-Standarte: The 122nd SS-Standarte was a regimental command of the Allgemeine-SS that was formed in the city of Strasbourg during World War II.  The Standarte was activated on November 12, 1940, and reached battalion strength by the end of the year.  The command was a successor to the previously disbanded 121st SS-Standarte, also situated in Strasbourg.
